initial.name: mcp_call__fixture
initial.description: Invoke one tool published by MCP server "fixture" under its original tool name, with the server's normal permissions, approvals, and timeouts.

arguments.description: Arguments object for the tool, matching its JSON Schema parameters.

initial.name: mcp_describe__fixture
initial.description: Describe one tool published by MCP server "fixture", including its complete JSON Schema parameters.

initial.name: mcp_discover__fixture
initial.description: Search the tools published by MCP server "fixture". Returns compact names and descriptions with paging; use mcp_describe__fixture for one tool's full parameter schema and mcp_call__fixture to invoke it.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of a tool name or description; omit to list every tool.

offset.description: Number of matching tools to skip (default 0).

limit.description: Maximum entries to return (default and maximum 25).
